newsitem.title: CHINA: China to produce 9.5 million motorcycles in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China to produce 9.5 million motorcycles in 1996.

text.p: China is expected to produce 9.5 million motorcycles in 1996, 2.5 million more units than last year, the International Business Daily said on Monday.
Stockpiles of domestically-made motorcycles had reached 680,000 in the first half of 1996 as the domestic market grew more competitive, the newspaper said. It gave no comparative figures.
Many domestic motorcycle makers had slashed prices to try to maintain their market shares and had also started turning to international markets, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
